# Field Track full brief

Field Track is a held MVP for managers of small field teams. It combines administrator-enrolled Android tracking, an offline native point queue, freshness-aware status, server-managed retention, route history, and a team-scoped manager dashboard.

The employee app tracks continuously after enrollment. It does not expose start, stop, pause, or unenroll controls. Android's foreground-service notification remains visible. The system keeps no signal, stale signal, off duty, and server policy decisions distinct.

The public dashboard is the real manager interface using fictional employees and routes. It has no production database binding. The MVP path works, but business economics and physical-device Android testing remain unresolved. There is no production rollout. Reopen only after a real-device pilot and the business case hold up.
